svg.aria-label: High level architecture: Contoso demo CSVs or a client's export land as data/input/sales_flat.csv (Bronze, 35 columns, 2,098,633 rows); the notebook maps 11 columns into output/sales.csv and Power Query types them (Silver); Power Query and DAX build a star of 1 fact and 3 dimensions (Semantic); 10 DAX measures (Analytical); the fixed and slow Power BI reports and the check numbers in powerbi/06-checks.md (Consume). There is no Gold step: the fix adds no business rules.

svg.text: Python + DuckDB, then Power BI Desktop
• or the client drops it in
prepare_data.py builds Bronze (demo) · analysis.ipynb builds Silver and writes the check numbers
Power BI Desktop builds the model and pages
Semantic, Analytical and the reports, click by click from powerbi/08-build-checklist.md
